in_hebrew.name: חנדל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew word 'hanad', meaning 'to be gracious' or 'to show favor'. It conveys the idea of God's grace and beauty bestowed upon an individual.

in_greek.name: Χανδρηλ
in_greek.long_meaning: A name derived from the Greek word 'chandrēlos', meaning 'graceful'. It reflects the beauty and elegance of the divine grace.

in_latin.name: Handalis
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latinized form of the Greek name 'Chandrēlos', meaning 'graceful'. It emphasizes the divine grace bestowed upon the bearer.
